items.t: Zoom Communications: The Core Business Trades At Just 9x FCF, With Anthropic Upside On Top
items.sum: Zoom Communications (ZM) stock is a strong buy, as its core trades at roughly 9x free cash flow, with an estimated $3.83 billion Anthropic stake adding upside.

items.t: Zoom: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.sum: Zoom's $4.7 billion buyback now runs alongside a new dividend, raising the question of how much capital it can return while still funding AI development.

items.t: What Does Zoom Communications (ZM) Naming A New Asia Head Mean For Investors?

items.t: Zoom earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.sum: Investing.com -- Zoom Communications (ZM) beat on both lines in FY2027 Q3 (reported Nov 23, 2026) and raised guidance. Its stock still trades about 16% lower than three months ago. The beat was clean, so the debate is now about growth durability and AI competition.

items.t: Pandemic Darling Zoom Is Starting to Pay Dividends
items.sum: Zoom just announced its first dividend, and Wall Street barely blinked. A cash-rich software company sits far below its pandemic peak, and one number looks like a bargain until you check what is hiding inside it.
